appearance_facts.fact: Y-axis scale ranges from 0 to 25, with labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, and 25.
X-axis scale ranges from 2005 to 2014, with labeled ticks for each year.
A single blue line connects data points for each year from 2005 to 2014.
Each data point is marked with a black dot and has its value labeled above it.
The data point for 2005 is at a value of 23.9.

public_definitions: Review the reservoir storage dashboard for the 2005-2014 review period, determine whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, then submit the appropriate routing decision.
Use the dashboard to determine whether the full-period reservoir storage change should enter substantial-change follow-up or remain in routine monitoring.
